name: Shilpa Medicare Ltd
tagline: Broad FY26 oncology-API/CDMO inflection (rev +18%, EBITDA +30%, adj PAT +135%) with a dated FY27-28 launch pipeline, but a fresh Jadcherla USFDA Form 483, single-digit reported returns and a ~Rs 17,400 Cr market cap cap the upside
business_overview: Shilpa Medicare is a pharmaceutical API and CDMO company pivoting toward oncology (APIs, biologics, NCEs, peptides, transdermal, OTF/orally-disintegrating-film formulations) with partnerships including CDMO licensing deals for Lantern Pharma's oncology molecules (LP-184, LP-284).
fundamentals_table: ~11% reported; ~17.4% adjusted (ex biologics/NBE), up from ~4% in FY23
FY26 revenue +18% to Rs 1,549 Cr; Q1 FY27 revenue +45% YoY to Rs 469 Cr, PAT +115% to Rs 101 Cr
Q1 FY27 (Jun-26): record revenue, PAT +115% YoY on licensing + EU/US formulation + biologics; ADC GMP facility commissioned Jun-26; Nov-25 Jadcherla Form 483 (8 obs) unresolved
Net debt ~Rs 613 Cr; net debt/EBITDA ~1.4x; gross D/E ~0.25
fundamentals_narrative: The inflection is now a full-year FY26 trend, not one quarter: revenue Rs 1,549 Cr (+18%), EBITDA Rs 445 Cr (~29% margin, up from 21% in FY24), adjusted PAT Rs 232 Cr (+135%), with operating cash flow at 141% of PAT. FY26 segment mix: API Rs 769 Cr (oncology Rs 455 Cr), formulations Rs 618 Cr (EU Rs 223 Cr, US Rs 80 Cr), biologics Rs 150 Cr (doubled YoY). Q1 FY27 accelerated further (revenue +45% YoY, PAT +115%). Adjusted ROCE has climbed from ~4% (FY23) to ~17.4%, but reported ROE/ROCE are still single-digit (~9%/11%) because the biologics/NBE capital block does not yet earn a return. Net debt is ~Rs 613 Cr (1.4x EBITDA, improving) - the prior write-up's 'D/E 0.05' was incorrect. Against this, a fresh Nov-2025 USFDA Form 483 with 8 observations at the Jadcherla Unit IV sterile-injectables export site (which carried a 2020 warning letter, since resolved), a Raichur Form 483 (Mar-2025) and a July-2026 Class II Pemetrexed recall are a live regulatory-quality overhang that corroborates a trusted holder's caution.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 770 available posts (Oct 2023-Jul 2026). Sentiment turned notably more bullish through 2026 as results beat expectations, with a VP-trusted long-term holder explicitly increasing exposure calling it 'harvesting time' after years of execution, while another VP-trusted long-term holder raised a genuine overdiversification/compliance caution flag in the same period.
community_signal: VALUE2017 (elevated-tier, invested 5 years) raised a substantive caution in Apr 2026 questioning whether the company is overdiversifying across API, formulation, NCE, biologics, peptides, transdermal, and OTF simultaneously, and noted 'compliance level is also not very encouraging.' Prabhat_Mohanty (elevated-tier) responded the same day that after reviewing a detailed research report, 'this appears to be harvesting time after so many years of planning and execution' and indicated he may increase exposure. Akshada_Deo (non-trusted) confirmed 'great Q4 results' beating her own estimates (May 2026). Mahigiri21 (non-trusted) flagged the CDMO relationship with Lantern Pharma for two oncology molecules (LP-184, LP-284) as an underappreciated catalyst, though a related Lantern Pharma partner drug (Unicycive's OLC) received an FDA rejection in Jun 2026 - management had already guided no major FY27 revenue was expected from that specific asset.
